effect.name: Apple Macintosh II 256-Color Palette (Switch)
effect.description: This shader uses the 256-color palette from Macintosh II and also adds dithering.
effect.author: Foxioo (Color palette is based from this website: https://belkadan.com/blog/2018/01/Color-Palette-8/)

parameter.name: /* Foxioo Apple Macintosh II 256-Color Palette (Switch) Shader | 2026.08.22 */
parameter.description: This shader uses the 256-color palette from Macintosh II and also adds dithering.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable manages which color will be reduced. Set to 0 is the blend color will be reduced and set to 1 is the base color will be reduced.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Dithering Size
parameter.description: This variable determines how visible Dithering should be.

parameter.name: Add Color
parameter.description: Specifies how much should be added to the RGB colors.

parameter.name: Multiply Color
parameter.description: Specifies by how much the RGB colors should be multiplied.
